verses.text: A good name is worth wanting more than piles of money. Being loved and respected beats silver and gold.
Rich and poor people have something in common. The LORD made every one of them.
Someone with good sense spots danger and gets out of sight. People who don't know better keep walking and pay for it.
Humility and standing in awe of the LORD lead to wealth, honor, and life.
The wicked walk a road full of thorns and traps. Anyone guarding their life stays well clear.
Teach a child the road to walk, and when they're old they'll still stick to it.
Rich people rule over poor people. Borrow money and you become a servant to the lender.
Plant wickedness and you'll harvest trouble. The rod you swing in anger will be broken.
People who look for ways to give will be blessed. They share their food with the poor.
Send the mocker packing and the fighting goes with them. The arguments and insults finally stop.
A person who loves a clean heart and speaks with grace will have the king for a friend.
The LORD keeps watch over knowledge. He trips up the words of people who break trust.
The lazy person says, “There's a lion outside! I'll get killed in the street!”
The mouth of a woman who breaks her marriage vows is a deep pit. Whoever is under the LORD's anger will fall in.
Foolishness is tied up tight in a child's heart. The rod of discipline drives it far away.
Squeeze poor people to get ahead or hand gifts to the rich, and either way you'll end up poor.
Lean in and hear what wise people say. Give your heart to what I'm teaching you.
It'll bring you joy to keep these words inside, ready to say when you need them.
I'm teaching you today, yes, you, so you'll put your trust in the LORD.
Haven't I written down thirty excellent sayings for you, full of advice and knowledge?
They teach you true words you can rely on, so you can give a solid answer to the people who sent you.
Don't take advantage of someone just because they're poor. Don't crush people in need when they're in court.
The LORD will argue their case, and he'll take the lives of those who rob them.
Don't become friends with a hothead. Don't hang around someone who nurses their anger.
You might pick up their ways and set a trap for your own life.
Don't be one of those people who shake hands on a deal to cover someone else's debt.
If you've got no way to pay, why risk having your bed taken out from under you?
Don't move the old boundary stone your ancestors set up.
See someone who's good at their work? They'll serve kings. They won't be working for people nobody knows.
